## Pre-merge checklist
- [ ] `npm run test` — all stable tests pass
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` — no type errors
- [ ] `npx eslint .` — no lint errors
- [ ] `npm run build` — production build succeeds
- [ ] CircleCI pipeline passes on this branch
- [ ] No new `any` types or `!` non-null assertions introduced
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials in the diff
